evidence: p645 Feria V Off. lect. no.2 'Benedictus * Dominus in aeternum. Euouae' m6f, ref Ps 88,53; CAO 1721; PM 207. Engraved f g h f | g fe d f g g f ; Euouae h h f gh g f. 11065 (Verona) 'Be(f)ne(g)di(h)ctus(f) Do(g)mi(fe)nus(d) in(f) ae(g)ter(g)num(f)' with single-note 'di' (h), Euouae identical. 18537 (Cistercian 1955, group 1969) has 'dic(gh) tus(gf)' and 'nus(dc)', not engraved.
